title: Monitoring and Evaluation on Agricultural and Rural development Projects

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts, principles, and importance of monitoring and evaluating agricultural and rural development projects.
Understand methods for collecting information for monitoring and evaluating agricultural and rural development projects.
Analyze collected data to support decision-making and policy evaluation in agricultural and rural development projects.
Plan, organize, and write reports for monitoring and evaluating agricultural and rural development projects.
Work collaboratively in teams to choose topics and solve problems related to economic, financial, and business issues using monitoring and evaluation methods.

prerequisite_courses: Investment Development in Agriculture and Rural Areas
